edges.description: The shifted external light-dark schedule places internal rhythms out of phase with the destination schedule.
Circadian misalignment and travel-related sleep loss produce the clinical sleep and daytime-function manifestations.
Daytime fatigue is a primary manifestation of the symptom cluster.
Loss of mental efficiency is a recognized daytime manifestation.
Weakness is a recognized manifestation of the symptom cluster.
Sleep disturbance is a primary manifestation of the symptom cluster.
Irritability is a recognized downstream manifestation.

nodes.description: Armodafinil, the R-enantiomer of modafinil, is a wake-promoting symptomatic treatment studied for excessive sleepiness after eastward transmeridian travel. It should be distinguished from racemic modafinil, which contains both R- and S-modafinil.

evidence.reference_title: A phase 3, double-blind, randomized, placebo-controlled study of armodafinil for excessive sleepiness associated with jet lag disorder.
evidence.snippet: Armodafinil at 150 mg/d provided a significant benefit in sleep latency on the MSLT (days 1-2: mean, 11.7 minutes vs 4.8 minutes for placebo; P<.001)

evidence.snippet: Nine of the ten trials found that melatonin, taken close to the target bedtime at the destination (10pm to midnight), decreased jet-lag from flights crossing five or more time zones.

evidence.reference_title: Melatonin for the prevention and treatment of jet lag.
